posts.title: The Portal at Moritzplatz
posts.description: Clubbing is one of the most sophisticated things humans do. We just pretend it isn’t.

posts.title: The Belief Factory: Manufacturing Common Sense in the Answer Engine Era
posts.description: Generative AI isn’t just generating text, it’s becoming the way we perceive and create our beliefs. Here I trace the shift from output control to input control: how surveillance, persuasion machines, and “answer engines” can manufacture what feels like common sense before you’ve even had a chance to decide what you believe.

posts.title: The Things Apple Made Me
posts.description: Apple named John Ternus its new CEO. Here's what the Prophet, the Custodian, and the Maker reveal about the company's shape — and what it means to be made by something you love and nearly stopped believing in.
